name: Empirical Volume Shading with Indirect Light Approximation
definition: A shading model that approximates indirect light transport in participating media by blurring direct light within a local neighborhood (cone) and using a separate indirect attenuation term, avoiding the computational cost of full global illumination.
summary: Empirical Volume Shading with Indirect Light Approximation is a real-time model that approximates global illumination by blurring direct light in a local cone and applying indirect attenuation, enabling interactive frame rates without pre-computed caches.
